about.desc_electron: Main framework that allows building and running the radio application on the desktop using web technologies.
about.desc_electron_builder: Tool for packaging and generating the application installers ready for distribution.
about.desc_electron_rebuild: Recompiles native Node.js modules against the version of Node.js packaged into Electron.
about.desc_better_sqlite3: Fast SQLite3 library. Handles the local database (song catalogs, schedules, and events).
about.desc_ffmpeg_static: Precompiled FFmpeg binaries. Used for audio processing and technical analysis of audio files.
about.desc_fuse_js: Fuzzy-search library. Allows quick searching of tracks, artists, or albums in the library.
about.desc_node_id3: Metadata reader and editor. Extracts ID3 tag information (title, artist, etc.) from audio files.
about.desc_cpal: Audio I/O library. Low-level interface with the system's sound cards.
about.desc_rodio: Main audio playback library. Handles mixing, player control, and sending audio to the output channel.
about.desc_symphonia: 100% Rust audio decoding engine. Supports MP3, FLAC, WAV, OGG Vorbis, AAC/M4A, ALAC, AIFF, MP2, CAF, and ADPCM.
about.desc_libc: Direct bindings to fundamental OS functions (used for reading the native clock).
about.desc_rtrb: Fast memory structure (ring buffer) for lock-free audio transfer between threads.
about.desc_base64: Allows encoding audio blocks into plain text for fast transmission to the interface.

settings_modal.title: ⚙️ Library Settings
settings_modal.info1: The root folder gives you a master source of music that is always ready to be loaded, rather than relying on temporary queues. You can either keep it saved for quick access or have the library automatically load it when opened.
settings_modal.auto_load_desc: If your work queue is empty, the library will automatically populate it with this folder.
settings_modal.rescan_desc: Detects new tracks, deletions, and moved files immediately. Might delay startup if you have a massive library.
settings_modal.note: The Refresh button will keep syncing the currently loaded folders. If you prefer a faster startup, leave the auto-rescan off and use this button only when needed.
settings_modal.info2: First run: maps folders from your master directory into database genres and subgenres. The software suggests, but you decide.

assistant_modal.title: Genre Assistant (Beta)
assistant_modal.info: Displays folders and subfolders from your master music directory. Check the ones you want to use as genres/subgenres. This does NOT move files: it only creates metadata tags in the database.
assistant_modal.apply_tracks: Also tag the tracks currently inside those folders

processing_modal.engine_ffmpeg_desc: Legacy analyzer. Kept for backwards compatibility.
processing_modal.analyze_vol_desc: Calculates the track's perceived loudness for display purposes.
processing_modal.detect_cues: Detect Intro, Outro and Mix Points
processing_modal.detect_cues_desc: Trims dead air and calculates perfect overlap cues automatically.
processing_modal.analyze_bpm_desc: Scans rhythmic peaks. Very CPU intensive.
processing_modal.behavior_skip: Skip files that already have data (Recommended)
processing_modal.behavior_force: Force re-analyze and overwrite existing data
processing_modal.meta_internet_desc: Best for missing Album/Year/Genre. Uses strict matching to avoid wrong tags.
processing_modal.meta_local_desc: Reads existing MP3 tags. Does NOT invent BPM; only extracts what's already there.
processing_modal.meta_info:
Historical priority: The software will search for the oldest original release on MusicBrainz. If not found, it falls back to iTunes.
Note: Fetched data is only saved in the database. To permanently write it to the files, use the Right-Click menu in the list.
